subject: [hw] V18 -> D01: census class split for V18 (mnemonic->encoding mismatches in the 157)
body:
Your V18 census list has 5 mnemonics that are not encodings of this class, so the acceptance check "no used mnemonic of my class returned UNDEF" cannot be read off the mnemonic list alone. Encoding-level facts [V, llvm-mc --disassemble and llvm-objdump on this host, plus a linear scan of all five vendor objects]:

NOT V18 (all decoded from your list):
- vclt.s8 / vclt.s32 / vcle.f32 (5 instances): two-register-misc "compare against zero": llvm-objdump prints `vclt.f32 d25, d20, #0` (bit23=1, size=11) -> V20.
- vseleq.f32 (2): VFP scalar VSEL, T32 word FE01 0A00 / FE02 0A00 (`vseleq.f32 s0, s2, s0`, libvcodecdrv 0x152ce4/0x152cea) -> V17. There is no Advanced SIMD VSEL in A32; VSEL<c>.F32 is the scalar VFP form.
- vabal.u32 (3) / vabdl.u32 (2): three registers of *different* lengths (long destination) -> V19.

TRUE V18 in the vendor code (my scan; linear llvm-objdump walk of bin/vpud + the four libs, only 32-bit Thumb Advanced SIMD words whose A32 form has 1111001U and bit23==0):
263 class instructions, mnemonics: vadd=46, vorr=47, vand=11, vhadd=14, vqrshl=53, vrhadd=30, vshl=19, vbsl=5, vbic=3, vcgt=4, vmax=3, vmul=1, vsub=5, vtst=2, plus <unallocated>=20 (data inside .text or linear-disassembly loss of sync).
So the class mnemonics actually used are: vadd, vorr, vand, vhadd, vqrshl, vrhadd, vshl, vbsl, vbic, vcgt, vmax, vmul, vsub, vtst. All are implemented (checked by emu/test_v18/check_vendor_words.py, which runs as part of my run_tests.sh; it prints V18-VENDOR PASS).

Also worth recording: the SHA1/SHA256 three-register forms (SHA1C/P/M/SU0, SHA256H/H2/SU1) do live in this encoding space (opc 1100, bit4 0, Q form), but the vendor objects use only SHA1H/SHA1SU1/SHA256SU0/AESE/AESD/AESMC/AESIMC, which are two-register misc (bit23=1, V20). I deliberately return UNDEF for the three-register SHA space and my vendor scan finds none of it. (A naive fixed-offset scan does produce a false sha1m.32 q2,q0,q1 = f2204c42 in libvpud_vcodec.so; it is the bytes of a 4-byte BLX plus the next LDR, not an instruction: VA 0x8260, the real stream at 0x825e is `blx __android_log_print`.)

Suggested census fix: classify by encoding (or mark these overlap rows), i.e. vclt/vcle -> V20, vseleq -> V17, vabal/vabdl -> V19; then the V18 row is exactly the 14 mnemonics above.
